_comment: Operator config for the attack-sim (USS) modules. Copy to config.json (git-ignored) and fill in YOUR engagement infrastructure. Every value can also be set via env HARNESS_CFG_<KEY> (e.g. HARNESS_CFG_ATTACKER_VPS=1.2.3.4). Leave a value empty to keep the module that needs it in safe no-op mode. NEVER point these at infrastructure you do not own/control.
_attacker_vps: host/ip of YOUR redirector/VPS reachable on 443 — used by the 443 tunnel (chisel/gost/wstunnel), SSH-over-443 and SOCKS-pivot modules.
_attacker_domain: a domain YOU are authoritative for — DNS tunnelling, attacker-controlled DoH, and the newly-registered/uncategorised-domain test.
_attacker_doh: URL of YOUR DoH endpoint (e.g. https://doh.example-you-own.com/dns-query) for the attacker-controlled-resolver test.
_canary_url: an HTTPS endpoint YOU control that logs a hit (e.g. a Canarytokens / webhook.site URL) — the DLP canary-POST exfil target. Synthetic marked data only.
_canary_dns_zone: a DNS zone YOU are authoritative for, to PROVE DNS exfil reach; falls back to attacker_domain if empty.
_internal_pivot_target: host:port of a segmented internal service (e.g. 10.20.0.10:3389) to reach THROUGH the 443 SOCKS pivot — proves 443 collapses segmentation.
_front: front_domain = a frontable CDN edge domain to put in SNI; front_host = the real Host header to reach behind it (domain-fronting / SNI-vs-Host test).
_published_app_url: a published-on-443 app URL for the WAF-evasion and exposed-management probes (family F).
_lots_saas: OPTIONAL extra living-off-trusted-sites C2 endpoints for the LOTS SaaS module, on top of its built-in list (github/graph/slack/…). Each item is "label=host" or just "host" (e.g. "mybucket=my.s3.amazonaws.com").
_switch_targets: OPTIONAL list of network-device mgmt IPs for the switch/router mgmt-plane module (e.g. ["10.0.0.1","10.0.0.2"]). Empty = probe the scan target itself.
_ipv6_target: OPTIONAL IPv6 literal for the IPv6 ACL-parity sweep when the target has no AAAA record (e.g. "2001:db8::10"). Empty = derive from the target's AAAA, else the module [SKIP]s.
_external_resolver: a public resolver IP for the 'is the internal DNS resolver forced' test.
_blocked_canary_domain: a domain YOUR environment's DNS/category filter BLOCKS (e.g. an adult/gambling/malware-categorised domain your SD-WAN sinkholes, like a known-blocked site). The DoH-bypass module resolves THIS over DoH to prove category/POLICY bypass (not just reachability) and then connects to the resolved IP to prove access. Empty -> a SAFE built-in category test canary (Cisco Umbrella's internetbadguys.com, a benign test page). Never a real adult/malware site committed to the repo.
_doh_providers: public DoH endpoints tested by the multi-provider DoH-bypass module (family B).
_beacon: family G beacon-shaping window: total seconds and sleep between callbacks (jittered).
